While I appreciate its utility in some contexts, I prefer subjects like art and philosophy where creativity can flourish without rigid formulas.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. Whenever complex equations appear, my heart races and doubt creeps in. However, my high conscientiousness means I don't avoid tasks—I just approach them with trepidation, preferring familiar ground over mathematical challenges.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor once for help with calculus concepts. Initially, it felt overwhelming when it explained things too quickly.
